# Docker

The Docker containers of the host. `osapi behavior get --name docker` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method list

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Description | List the containers of the host                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Detail      | Reads each container through gohai's docker collector, which runs docker ps and docker inspect. state limits the list to the running or the stopped ones. A host whose docker does not answer reports skipped. The environment of a container shows only the names of its variables: osapi never reads their values. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/container/docker                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Permission  | container:read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Command     | [osapi client node container docker list](../../../usage/cli/client/node/container/docker/list.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Output type | \[]Entry                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                | DESCRIPTION                                                             |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| state | string | no       | one of running stopped all | Only the containers in this state: running, stopped or all, the default |

### Output (11)

| FIELD     | TYPE   | DESCRIPTION                                                                      |
| --------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id        | string | The container's full ID                                                          |
| name      | string | The container's name                                                             |
| image     | string | The image it runs                                                                |
| state     | string | running, exited, created, paused or restarting                                   |
| summary   | string | What docker says of its state, such as Up 2 minutes                              |
| created   | string | When it was created, RFC 3339                                                    |
| health    | string | The state of its health check: healthy, unhealthy or starting; empty without one |
| ports     | array  | The published ports, host:port-&gt;container port                                |
| mounts    | array  | The mounts, source:destination, with :ro when read only                          |
| networks  | array  | The networks, with the container's address and gateway on each                   |
| env_names | array  | The names of its environment variables; osapi never reads their values           |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                 | INPUT         | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A host with a container | (none)        | \[created=2026-11-22T10:00:00Z, env_names=\[PATH APP_TOKEN], id=3f4e8a1b2c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7, image=alpine:3.20, mounts=\[/srv/data:/data:ro], name=osapitest, networks=\[bridge 172.17.0.2 via 172.17.0.1], ports=\[0.0.0.0:8080-&gt;80/tcp], state=running, summary=Up 2 minutes] |
| Only the stopped ones   | state=stopped |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

## Method create

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | create                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Description | Create a container                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Detail      | Runs docker create, which pulls the image when the host does not have it. The environment goes on docker's standard input, not in its arguments, which each user of the host can read. auto_start starts the container once it is made. A container of the name that the host has already is not made again, and reports changed: false. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/container/docker                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Permission  | container:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Command     | [osapi client node container docker create](../../../usage/cli/client/node/container/docker/create.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Input type  | CreateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

### Input (9)

| FIELD              | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                            | DESCRIPTION                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name               | string  | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]\*$                | The container's name                                                                  |
| image              | string  | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9._/:@-]\*$             | The image to run, such as alpine:3.20; docker pulls it when the host does not have it |
| container_hostname | string  | no       | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9.-]\*$, max length 253 | The hostname inside the container                                                     |
| dns                | array   | no       |                                                        | The DNS servers of the container                                                      |
| command            | array   | no       |                                                        | The command, in place of the image's own                                              |
| env                | object  | no       | format password                                        | The environment variables of the container                                            |
| ports              | array   | no       |                                                        | The published ports, each host:container, such as 8080:80                             |
| volumes            | array   | no       |                                                        | The bind mounts, each host:container, such as /srv/data:/data                         |
| auto_start         | boolean | no       |                                                        | Start the container once it is created                                                |

### Output (3)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                         |
| ------- | ------- | ----------------------------------- |
| name    | string  | The container                       |
| id      | string  | The container's full ID, for create |

## Method stop

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | stop                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Description | Stop a container                                                                                                                                                               |
| Detail      | Runs docker stop, which waits timeout seconds before docker kills the container, or docker's default of 10 when it is 0. A container that does not run reports changed: false. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/container/docker/&#123;name&#125;/stop                                                                                                          |
| Permission  | container:execute                                                                                                                                                              |
| Command     | [osapi client node container docker stop](../../../usage/cli/client/node/container/docker/stop.md)                                                                             |
| Input type  | StopInput                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                         |

### Input (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                             | DESCRIPTION                                                     |
| ------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name    | string  | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]\*$ | The container's name or ID                                      |
| timeout | integer | no       | min 0, max 300                          | Seconds to wait before docker kills it; docker's default when 0 |

### Output (3)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                         |
| ------- | ------- | ----------------------------------- |
| name    | string  | The container                       |
| id      | string  | The container's full ID, for create |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed            |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                       | INPUT                     | OUTPUT                        |

| Stop a container              | name=osapitest, timeout=1 | name=osapitest, changed=true  |
| A container that does not run | name=osapitest, timeout=1 | name=osapitest, changed=false |

## Method exec

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | exec                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Description | Run a command in a container                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Detail      | Runs docker exec, and answers what the command wrote to standard output and to standard error, and its exit code. A command that exits with a code other than 0 is an answer, not a failure. It changes what the command changes, which osapi cannot tell, so it reports changed: true. Its permission is container:exec, which only the admin role gets, apart from the container:execute of start, stop and image pull. An agent with agent.command.enabled false refuses it, as it refuses a command. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/container/docker/&#123;name&#125;/exec                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Permission  | container:exec                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Command     | [osapi client node container docker exec](../../../usage/cli/client/node/container/docker/exec.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Input type  | ExecInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Output type | ExecResult                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

### Input (4)

| FIELD       | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                             | DESCRIPTION                           |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| name        | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]\*$ | The container's name or ID            |
| command     | array  | yes      |                                         | The command and its arguments         |
| env         | object | no       | format password                         | Environment variables for the command |
| working_dir | string | no       | pattern ^/                              | The directory the command runs in     |

### Output (4)

| FIELD     | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                             |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| stdout    | string  | What the command wrote to standard output               |
| stderr    | string  | What the command wrote to standard error                |
| exit_code | integer | The command's exit code                                 |
| changed   | boolean | Always true: osapi cannot tell what the command changed |

### Examples (1)

| EXAMPLE       | INPUT                                 | OUTPUT                                            |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| Run a command | name=osapitest, command=\[echo hello] | stdout=hello , stderr=, exit_code=0, changed=true |
